about: live-36 (3) — the fixed regression set (the yardstick). Rubrics, not fixed answers: `any` = groups the answer must hit (relaxed), `stale` = wrong claims (strict fails), `rows` = exact list/table rows (strict), `gold` = groups that must be in what the model RECEIVED (retrieval; defaults to `any`), `official` = a host the sources should include, `review` = what a reviewer checks by reading. Gold as of 2026-10-22 (apple.com: iPhone 18 Pro / 18 Pro Max / iPhone Duo / Air / 17 / 17e / 16). General knowledge only; the LIB questions run on the UI-test sample library.
